title: API Performance Testing: How to Design Realistic Tests
why_read: A general overview of designing realistic API performance tests covers well-known territory that experienced engineers likely already know.
analysis: This article walks through basic performance testing concepts, types of load tests, and considerations like matching test environments to production and handling external service dependencies. It's a reasonable primer for engineers new to performance testing, but doesn't appear to introduce novel techniques or deep technical insight beyond standard practice. The content is competent but generic, more suited to junior engineers than as a genuinely fresh technical read.
